themes.title: Take the simple ball in
themes.why: Twice you had a pass into the box that was there for the taking — one from the byline, one with a single defender to beat — and you chose the safe ball instead, so drill finishing those moves with the delivery in, not around.

themes.title: First look into the box
themes.why: Six times you turned back or played square in the final third when the ball forward was on, so train your players to check their shoulder before it arrives and make the pass in the first thought, not the last resort.

themes.title: Fill the box with runners
themes.why: Almost every time you attacked down the left the ball came back out, and a pass into the box only exists if someone is arriving in it — so work on timing runs to the near post, penalty spot and back post every time the ball goes wide.
